main.description: Earthquake-specific facts of a hazard notice. Used together with dev.jisaku.mosimo.hazard; the origin time is its onset and shaking intensity is one of its scales.

kind.description: event: an earthquake that occurred. early-warning: a forecast issued before shaking arrives; the hypocenter and magnitude are estimates. assessment: an evaluation of heightened likelihood, not a specific earthquake.

hypocenter.description: Epicenter coordinates, depth and name. Not an affected area. Omit coordinates that are unknown; never derive them from the name.

lat.description: WGS 84 latitude in millionths of a degree.

lon.description: WGS 84 longitude in millionths of a degree.

depth.description: Depth below the surface in millimeters. Omit when unknown or only qualitative; never 0 for unknown.

value.description: Magnitude times ten (M6.5 is 65). Omit the whole object when unknown; never 0 for unknown.

type.description: Magnitude type such as Mj, Mw, ML, mb or Ms. Omit when unknown.
